violation_type.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))
violation_type.typical_finding: Three staff did not have a completed Pre-Employment Affidavit in their personnel record.

finding_variants.text: Three staff did not have a completed Pre-Employment Affidavit in their personnel record.

During the inspection, the operation was missing the Form 2912 affidavits for its two employees.
